_meta.rootCause: build_glossary.py harvest pairs english-baseline/ember-0.6.0 against compendium/cn. In that baseline scenes.<X>.notes.* is keyed by document id (5fN2g192NkqHIof9), while both compendium/en and compendium/cn key the same notes by note text (Toraga). walk_pairs therefore matches zero note leaves and all 175 world-map place labels fall through to pending, although every one of them is already translated. The same id-vs-text key mismatch also hides notes on the Ordain Burial Grounds and Lake Jinro scenes.
_meta.fixSuggestion: harvest() should pair compendium/en against compendium/cn (same key scheme) instead of / in addition to the frozen english-baseline snapshot.
